expr: (() => { const S=window.simState, s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return S.A==='kuivain' && S.B==='lamppu' && s[0].value==='kuivain' && s[1].value==='lamppu' && s[2].value==='1' && Number(r[0].value)===5 && Number(r[1].value)===60 && S.nopeus===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: A hiustenkuivain 5 min, B lamppu 60 min, speed normaali (must run before any setup)
DOM order canvas, controls, readout; no button

expr: (() => { const o=(i)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')[i].options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.textContent).join('|'); const d='lamppu:lamppu|televisio:televisio|jaakaappi:jääkaappi|tosteri:tosteri|kuivain:hiustenkuivain|keitin:vedenkeitin|kiuas:sähkökiuas'; return document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select').length===3 && o(0)===d && o(1)===d && o(2)==='0.5:hidas|1:normaali|2:nopea' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three selects: laite A and B with seven devices, speed hidas 0,5 · normaali 1 · nopea 2

expr: (() => { const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]')]; return r.length===2 && r.every(x=>x.min==='1' && x.max==='1440' && x.step==='1') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two time sliders 1–1440 min in steps of 1 min
adapter declares A, tA, B and tB

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600x400

expr: (() => { const L=window.simState.labels.map(l=>l.s).join('|'); return L.includes('\\text{hiustenkuivain}') && L.includes('P_\\text{A} = 1{,}8\\,\\text{kW}') && L.includes('P_\\text{B} = 10\\,\\text{W}') && L.includes('E_\\text{A} = 540\\,\\text{kJ}') && L.includes('E\\ (\\text{kJ})') && L.includes('t\\ (\\text{h})') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: canvas labels (LaTeX): device, powers, energy, axis names
one legend line of at most 15 words
